tours.title: 🎉 Almaty, Kazakhstan Tour Package – New Year's Special Offer! 🎉
tours.overview: Embark on a winter wonderland escape to Almaty, Kazakhstan for the New Year! Enjoy snow-capped mountains, vibrant city streets, and local traditions.
inclusions: 4 nights in a 4-star hotel in Almaty

itinerary.title: Arrival & City Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to Almaty! Check in to your hotel and enjoy a panoramic city tour including Zenkov Cathedral and Panfilov Park.

itinerary.title: Charyn Canyon Adventure
itinerary.description: Witness the breathtaking wind-carved red sandstones of Charyn Canyon, also known as the Grand Canyon of Central Asia.

itinerary.title: Medeu & Shymbulak
itinerary.description: Take a cable car ride up to the Shymbulak Ski Resort and enjoy the panoramic alpine scenery at Medeu Gorge.

itinerary.title: Free Day or Kok-Tobe Hill
itinerary.description: Spend the day shopping at Green Bazaar or take a cable car to Kok-Tobe hill to see the city view.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Almaty International Airport for your departure flight.

tours.title: 🎉 Yerevan, Armenia Tour Package – Christmas Special Offer!
tours.overview: Experience a magical Christmas in Armenia, the oldest Christian nation. Explore historic churches, snowy peaks, and the festive capital of Yerevan.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Yerevan
itinerary.description: Arrival at Zvartnots International Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Free evening in Republic Square to see the Christmas tree.

itinerary.title: Yerevan City Tour & Cascade
itinerary.description: Explore Yerevan's Cascade Complex, Opera Theater, and history museums on a guided walk.

itinerary.title: Garni & Geghard
itinerary.description: Visit the pagan Garni Temple and the UNESCO-listed Geghard Monastery carved into the mountain rock.

itinerary.title: Tsaghkadzor Ropeway & Lake Sevan
itinerary.description: Enjoy the snow resort of Tsaghkadzor and visit Sevanavank Monastery overlooking the giant blue Lake Sevan.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to airport for your flight back home.

tours.title: Greece Tour Package
tours.overview: Embark on an unforgettable journey to Greece. Immerse yourself in the rich history and breathtaking landscapes of Athens, Santorini, and Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Athens Arrival
itinerary.description: Upon arrival, you will be met and transferred to your hotel. Free day to explore the historic city.

tours.title: Singapore Tour Package
tours.overview: Discover the futuristic city-state of Singapore. Visit Gardens by the Bay, Sentosa Island, and enjoy premium shopping and street food.

itinerary.title: Singapore Arrival
itinerary.description: Arrive at Changi Airport, transfer to hotel. In the evening, visit the Night Safari.

tours.title: Thailand Tour Package
tours.overview: Explore the vibrant streets of Bangkok and relax on the pristine beaches of Pattaya. A perfect short holiday escape.
inclusions: 3 nights hotel stay in Bangkok & Pattaya
Coral Island tour in Pattaya with lunch

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok
